The issuer has a massive asset base and strong gross margins, but is highly leveraged with total liabilities of nearly $298 billion against $104 billion in equity. Furthermore, profitability relative to the size of the balance sheet is modest (net income of $2.3 billion) and liquidity is slightly constrained with a current ratio of 0.91, aligning with investment-grade, mid-tier credit risk.

DECISION: BBB+
